verdict.rationale: LM Studio's homepage says users can talk to Bionic naturally with speech transcribed in real time, and that voice and audio data is processed locally and never leaves the device. That covers dictation, real-time transcription and on-device processing. The support rests only on brief marketing copy and is scoped to the Bionic app. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the dictation feature (which transcription model is used, language support, how to enable it), evidence of dictation in the core LM Studio chat app, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as claimed.
